translations.web: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces;
translations.bsb: were alternating carved cherubim and palm trees. Each cherub had two faces:
translations.kjv: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;
